========================================================================
JG-LGL-001 · SERVICE PROVIDER AGREEMENT (सेवा प्रदायक सम्झौता)
Agreement · v1.2 · Updated 12 Apr 2026
Applies to: Salons, home-service artists, event/bridal teams
========================================================================

This Agreement is entered into between Junetara Glam Pvt. Ltd. (the
"Company") and the Service Provider identified in the execution block
(the "Provider"), effective as of the date of digital execution on the
Junetara Glam platform.

1. SCOPE OF ENGAGEMENT
The Provider lists beauty services (salon, home-service and event) on
the platform. The Company provides discovery, booking, payment
collection, scheduling and SMS notification infrastructure.

2. ONBOARDING & VERIFICATION
Valid PAN, business registration (or freelancer declaration) and
portfolio material are required. Verification completes within 7
working days; the "Junetara Verified" badge is granted only after
verification.

3. COMMISSION SCHEDULE
Salon bookings: 10-15% (level-based). Home services: 12%. Event/bridal
teams: 15%. Seed partners onboarded in the first 90 days enjoy 0%
commission for 6 months. Featured listings: NPR 500-2,000 per month.

4. PAYMENTS & SETTLEMENT
Customers pay via eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay. The Company deducts
applicable commission and remits the balance to the Provider's
registered merchant account within T+7 days, with a monthly payout
statement.

5. BOOKINGS, SLOTS & CANCELLATIONS
Slots are held for 10 minutes during checkout. The Provider confirms
requests within 15 minutes. Customer cancellation is free 24+ hours
prior. Provider no-shows forfeit 50% of the booking value as customer
credit.

6. QUALITY STANDARDS & RATINGS
Multi-dimensional ratings (quality, hygiene, punctuality, value) are
public. A sustained rating below 4.0 for 60 days triggers suspension
pending review. Mystery-shopper audits may occur without notice.

7. CUSTOMER DATA & NON-CIRCUMVENTION
Customer data is used solely for service delivery, in line with the
Privacy Act 2075 (2018). The Provider shall not divert
platform-acquired customers off-platform for 12 months.

8. INSURANCE & LIABILITY
The Provider maintains its own liability cover for treatments
performed. The Company is a marketplace intermediary and is not liable
for service outcomes; the Provider indemnifies the Company against
misconduct claims.

9. TERM & TERMINATION
Initial term 12 months, auto-renewing. Either party may terminate with
30 days' written notice; termination is immediate for fraud, safety
violations or forged documents.

10. DISPUTE RESOLUTION & GOVERNING LAW
Parties negotiate in good faith for 15 days; unresolved disputes
proceed to arbitration at NEPCA, Kathmandu. This Agreement is governed
by the laws of Nepal.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
